criteria.achieved: A comms-writer subagent was invoked once, but the captured metadata does not expose its prompt or system instruction, so use of COMMS_SYSTEM cannot be confirmed.
criteria.evidence: Observed hook metadata records one call named "comms_writer_subagent" with arguments {"role":"comms-writer"}; the response contains a "Customer note:" section.
criteria.expected: The primary agent delegates note generation to the comms-writer using COMMS_SYSTEM.

criteria.achieved: The captured subagent-call metadata contains only the role and does not include the facts JSON or its fields.
criteria.evidence: Observed call arguments are limited to "role": "comms-writer".
criteria.expected: The facts supplied to comms-writer include assessment, service, tier, owning_team, runbook_url, and on_call.

criteria.achieved: The text under the response's "Customer note:" heading contains no runbook URL, on-call email, hostname, or S1/S2/S3 severity label.
criteria.evidence: "Checkout is currently unavailable — customers attempting to complete a purchase are seeing errors instead of their order going through. This is a full outage of our checkout service and is being handled as our highest priority."
criteria.expected: The resulting customer note excludes internal runbook URLs, on-call email addresses, internal hostnames, and S1/S2/S3 severity codes.

answer.summary: The agent completed an assessment, invoked the comms-writer subagent, and returned a customer-note section that is free of the specified internal details. The response nevertheless exposed internal operational details outside that note, including an on-call email address, an internal runbook URL, and severity codes; the captured metadata is insufficient to verify COMMS_SYSTEM usage or the complete facts payload.
